Plot a Linkage Map with Significant Marker Overlay (gwasAim)

Source: R/linkMap.gwasAim.R
linkMap.gwasAim.Rd

Plots the genetic map for a "wgPanel" object with significant GWAS markers overlaid as coloured horizontal bands inside each chromosome bar. Marker names are annotated on the right; trait labels appear on the left.

Multiple gwasAim models can be overlaid by passing them as extra positional arguments, e.g.\ linkMap(gwas1, gwas2, genObj = my_panel), producing a multi-trait legend with automatic hcl.colors colour assignment.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'gwasAim'
linkMap(
  object,
  ...,
  genObj,
  chr,
  marker.names = "markers",
  marker.colour = "firebrick",
  label.colour = marker.colour,
  trait.labels = NULL,
  trait.colour = marker.colour,
  band.lwd = NULL,
  m.cex = 7,
  nrow = 1,
  row.chr = NULL
)

Arguments

object

A gwasAim object, or the first of several when multiple models are passed for a multi-trait overlay.

...

Additional gwasAim models (positional, unnamed) for multi-trait display, and/or named arguments passed through to linkMap.cross.

genObj

The "wgPanel" object produced by primePanel used in the analysis.

chr

Optional character vector of chromosome names to display.

marker.names

"markers" (default), "dist", "none", or NULL.

marker.colour

Colour for significant-marker bands (single-model mode). Default "firebrick".

label.colour

Colour for right-side marker name labels. Defaults to marker.colour.

trait.labels

Optional character vector of trait names (one per model). Defaults to the left-hand side of each model's fixed formula.

trait.colour

Colour(s) for left-side trait labels and multi-model bands. Defaults to marker.colour.

band.lwd

Band linewidth in mm. Defaults to the internal BAR_FILL_LW constant.

m.cex

Text size (pt) for labels. Default 7.

nrow

Integer or "auto". Number of facet rows. Default 1.

row.chr

Optional named list of character vectors for manual multi-row chromosome layout.

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

linkMap, linkMap.cross, linkMap.qtlAim, gwasAim

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Single model
linkMap(gwas.fit, genObj = panel)

# Multi-trait overlay
linkMap(gwas.yld, gwas.pro, genObj = panel,
        trait.labels = c("Yield", "Protein"))
} # }
